description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a filter narrows the product list to matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows products, of which some match a given filter value and some do not. The tester knows (from the unfiltered list) which products match that value.
steps: Note the products shown in the unfiltered list and which of them match the chosen filter value.
Apply the filter with that value.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed: every product shown matches the applied filter value, and all products that match it are still shown.

cases.title: Products that do not match the applied filter are removed from the list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and contains at least one product that does not match the filter value to be applied.
steps: Identify a product in the unfiltered list that does not match the chosen filter value.
Apply the filter with that value.
Look for the identified product in the resulting list.
cases.expected: The non-matching product is no longer shown in the list.

cases.title: Applying a filter that no product matches
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and no product in the list matches the filter value to be applied.
steps: Apply the filter with a value that no product matches.
cases.expected: No products are shown, since none match the filter. The exact wording or appearance of any empty-result message is not specified in the story.
